DEPARTMENT OF ARABIC
PRAMATHESH BARUA COLLEGEs, GAURIPUR
P.O-GAURIPUR, DIST- DHUBRI, ASSAM, INDIA
1. Name and Address of the Department:                   ARABIC,
Pramathesh Barua College, Gauripur
Ward no-12 (New)
PO- Gauripur,
Dist- Dhubri, Assam
2. Date of establishment of the department:       2002
3. BRIEF HISTORY OF THE DEPARTMENT:
The department of Arabic is one of the departments among the departments of Pramathesh Barua College which had been established in 2002 run by Non-sanctioned teacher till April 2018. Now, it is being run by Sanctioned teacher. It offers only pass course that means regular course because of not sufficient teaching faculty in this department.
4. MISSION:
The department of Arabic was set up with a mission to import higher eduction on Arabic literature from higher secondary level to Degree level in general while imparting higher education on Arabic literature. The department is at present running with a mission to develop moral aspect of the students. The department is going to open the Major course if the faculty is available in the department. The department also gives due stress for all round development of the students in general so that the students can serve the as well as the in general and the college in particular.
5. GOAL AND OBJECTIVE:
The objective and goal of the particular department is to bring about improvement of the quality of students so that they can form their personal humanity, good society and nationality also.
6. BUILD UP AREA OF THE DEPARTMENT (In sqm):
Common space consisting of three departments which are Arabic, Hindi and Sanskrit
